projects.name: Madhav Stone ERP
projects.client: Client project for Madhav Stones Pvt. Ltd.
projects.summary: End-to-end inventory, stock and production tracking for a granite and marble business, with instant native PDF invoicing.
projects.description: A production-grade inventory and factory app for a stone-processing company. Every stage of stone processing syncs in real time across all devices on the factory floor, each team member sees only what their role allows, and sales and vendor reports export as PDFs straight from the app.
features: Replaces paper measurement books for granite / marble block and slab inventory
Instant itemized PDF bills and stock challans, ready to share on WhatsApp
Role-based access for Admin, Managers, Liners and Supervisors
Real-time sync of stone processing stages across devices (Firebase Firestore)
Live dashboards and machine-status views built with Jetpack Compose and StateFlow

projects.name: Gandhi Money AI
projects.summary: A personal expense and transaction manager with an offline-first database — add entries and ask questions by voice.
projects.description: An AI-integrated finance manager. Using Android 16's appFunctions framework, users add expenses and ask financial questions by voice through the Gemini AI agent. Material 3 dashboards with dynamic charts show spending trends and budget goals.
features: Sub-second offline transaction logging, no cloud wait and no forced sign-up
Voice-driven entries and money questions through Gemini (Android 16 App Functions)
Interactive Material 3 dashboards with spending-trend and budget charts
Clean MVVM architecture with Hilt and Room

projects.name: Silent Zone
projects.summary: Switches your phone to silent, vibrate or normal automatically — based on where you are.
projects.description: An automation app that changes the phone's sound profile on its own using geofencing and Wi-Fi triggers. Background work is tuned with WorkManager and Broadcast Receivers so it stays reliable while using very little battery, and it handles Android's strict background-location and Do Not Disturb permissions properly.
features: Ends manual phone muting in offices, temples / mosques, classrooms and meetings
Automatic Silent / Vibrate / Normal switching from geofencing and Wi-Fi triggers
Correct handling of background-location and Do Not Disturb permissions

projects.name: Groow
projects.summary: Billing, stock and udhaar (customer credit) for small shops — all from one phone.
projects.description: Groow lets shop owners run their counter from a phone: make bills, keep stock up to date and track udhaar (customer credit) in one place. A fresh light and dark redesign is on the way.
features: Light and dark themes (redesign in progress)

faq.q: How much does an app cost?
faq.a: It depends on the features, screens and integrations you need. Share your requirement through the form or WhatsApp and we send a clear roadmap and estimate, usually within a day. The first consultation is free.

faq.q: How long does it take to build an app?
faq.a: Timelines depend on the scope. After the first discussion we give you a timeline, and during development you get regular builds to test on your own phone.

faq.q: Do you support the app after launch?
faq.a: Yes. We handle the Play Store release, and after launch we take care of version updates, bug fixes and keeping the app healthy.

faq.q: Can you improve or rebuild my existing app?
faq.a: Yes. We modernize older Java/XML Android apps into Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, update them for the latest Android versions and reduce crashes and slowness.

faq.q: Will the app work without internet?
faq.a: For business apps we use an offline-first design: data is saved on the phone and syncs to the cloud when the internet is back, so work on the shop or factory floor never stops.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside Madhya Pradesh?
faq.a: Yes. We work remotely with clients across India and abroad, and visit on-site for business clients when needed.
We specialise in native Android apps built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Tell us your plans and we will suggest the right approach.
